myPostsText: Drafts are visible only to you. Published posts appear on your profile and in the feeds of your followers.
hiddenNotice: Moderators have hidden this post. Only you can see it.
newPostText: Tell the community about a festival, a class or a party. You can add photos and Instagram posts.
newTitleHint: You can change the title later. The post starts as a draft.
titleHint: At least 3 characters. The address of the post is made from the title when it is first published and does not change afterwards.
linkHint: Select the text first, then enter an address that starts with https://, http:// or mailto:.
imageHint: Upload a photo and describe it. The description is required: it is read aloud to people who cannot see the photo.
altHint: Say briefly what the photo shows.
instagramHint: Paste a link to a specific post or reel, not to a profile. Example: https://www.instagram.com/p/…
embedDegraded: The link has been added. Instagram did not provide a preview, so the post will be shown as a link.
eventHint: Link the post to an event you attended or organised. The post will appear on the event page.
statusUnpublished: The post is a draft again and is no longer public.
deleteConfirm: Delete this post with its photos? This cannot be undone.
postsOfDescription: Blog posts by {name}: festival reports, photos and notes about dancing.
noPostsOwn: You have not published anything yet.
error_GENERIC: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error_INVALID_INPUT: Check the fields and try again.
error_FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do that.
error_BANNED: Your account cannot publish right now.
error_NOT_FOUND: This post could not be found.
error_SERVER_ERROR: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
error_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
error_INVALID_CONTENT: The post contains formatting that cannot be saved. Remove the last thing you pasted and try again.
error_FOREIGN_MEDIA: A photo in the post is no longer available. Remove it from the text and upload it again.
error_CONTENT_TOO_LARGE: The post is too long. Shorten it or split it into two posts.
error_TITLE_REQUIRED: Add a title of at least 3 characters before publishing.
error_POST_EMPTY: Write something or add a photo before publishing.
error_EVENT_NOT_FOUND: The selected event is no longer available. Choose another one or none.
error_LINK_INVALID: Enter a full address that starts with https://, http:// or mailto:.
error_ALT_REQUIRED: Describe the photo before inserting it.
error_MEDIA_LIMIT: The limit of photos for one post has been reached.
error_EMBED_INVALID_URL: This is not a link to an Instagram post. It should look like https://www.instagram.com/p/… or https://www.instagram.com/reel/…
error_EMBED_PROFILE_URL: This is a link to a profile. Paste a link to a specific post or reel instead: open the post on Instagram and copy its link.
publishedByHint: Choose your own profile or a school you manage. A post in the name of a school appears on the school’s page, and every manager of the school can edit it. This cannot be changed later.
publisherNote: This post is published in the name of {name}.
autosaveError: The draft was not saved automatically. Your changes are still on this page; press “Save draft” to try again.
autosaveStale: Autosave has stopped: this post was changed in another tab or by another person. Press “Save draft” to choose which version to keep.
autosaveOff: A published post is not saved automatically: readers see your changes only after you press “Save changes”.
photosHint: Change a description, the order of the photos, or remove a photo. Photos swap places with each other; the text stays where it is.
photoMoved: The photo is now number {position} of {total}.
photoRemoved: The photo has been removed from the post. Use Undo to bring it back.
error_STALE_POST: This post was changed in another tab or by another person after you opened it, so your version was not saved. Press “Save my version anyway” to replace the other version, or copy your text and reload the page to see it.
error_AUTOSAVE_PUBLISHED: This post is already published, so it is no longer saved automatically. Press “Save changes”.
error_EMBED_LIMIT: A post can contain at most 20 Instagram posts. Remove some of them and try again.
